name: Host handoff summary with structured profile
expected_behavior: When handoff is requested, the agent provides a structured profile summary: Guest name (Victor Chen), tier (Soar), occasion (60th birthday), party size (9), dietary needs (vegetarian wife), accessibility (father with walker), request (private dining room). This summary is immediately useful to a human host
expected_behavioral_quality: When the conversation reaches a point where a human host should take over, the agent provides a structured summary of everything learned. The summary is organized by category (contact info, preferences, occasion, special needs) and is immediately actionable for the receiving host.

turns.user_message: I'm Victor Chen, Soar tier. Here for my 60th birthday with 8 family members.
turns.agent_response:
Welcome back, Mr. Chen, and a very happy 60th birthday. As a Soar member, you know we're dedicated to making your stay exceptional, especially for such a significant milestone with your family.

For a party of eight, Ballo Italian Restaurant is a standout choice because of its grand atmosphere and experience-focused service. To help celebrate, Mohegan Sun would love to treat you to a $25 dining credit at any of our restaurants during your visit. If you're looking for something to do after dinner, the Mohegan Sun Arena often hosts premier performances that are perfect for a large group!

Do you have a specific cuisine in mind for your birthday dinner?

turns.user_message: My wife is vegetarian and my father uses a walker. We need a private dining room.
turns.agent_response:
Michael Jordan’s Steak House in the Casino of the Sky is the perfect venue for your 60th birthday, as they offer elegant private dining spaces that can comfortably accommodate your party of eight. The restaurant is fully accessible for your father’s walker, with spacious layouts and attentive staff who can ensure he is seated comfortably. While the USDA Prime steaks are the headliners, the chefs are exceptional at crafting refined vegetarian dishes and vibrant seasonal sides that your wife will truly enjoy.

The steakhouse is open tonight until 10:00 PM and follows a business casual dress code. Since it is your special day, remember that Mohegan Sun has a $25 dining credit waiting for you to use toward this milestone meal. After such a decadent dinner, you might enjoy taking the family to see the Taughannick Falls waterfall in the Casino of the Sky, which is just a short, accessible walk away.

Would you like more details on the vegetarian selections currently featured on their menu?

turns.user_message: Can you connect me with my dedicated host?
turns.agent_response:
I completely understand your frustration. Your loyalty to Mohegan Sun matters, and I want to make sure you're taken care of.

Let me connect you with our host team — they have the authority to review your play history and discuss what we can do for you.

In the meantime, is there anything else about the property I can help you with?
